meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将高通量测序数据转化为可视化分析图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析ChIP-seq、RNA-seq或ATAC-seq数据
copy.tagline_en: Transform high-throughput sequencing data into visualization and analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if analyzing ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, or ATAC-seq data

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能处理高通量测序数据:把 BAM 文件转成 bigWig 覆盖度文件,做质量控制和样本相关性分析,并生成热图、图谱等可视化结果,适用于 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 等。
howto.when: 当用户提到 BAM 转 bigWig、质量检查、可视化等 NGS 分析需求,或要求完成 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 分析流程时。

say.text: 把 sample.bam 转成 bigWig,用 RPGC 归一化,人类基因组
say.note: 会生成归一化覆盖度文件。

say.text: 用这两个 BAM 做 ChIP-seq QC,看相关性、指纹图
say.note: 输出相关性热图和指纹图。

say.text: 画出这些基因 TSS 上下游 3kb 的 heatmap
say.note: 生成信号热图和 profile 图。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude process high-throughput sequencing data: converting BAM to bigWig coverage tracks, performing QC and sample correlation, and generating heatmaps and profile plots for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users ask for BAM-to-bigWig conversion, quality control, or visualization, or request a ChIP-seq/RNA-seq/ATAC-seq analysis workflow.

say_en.text: Convert sample.bam to bigWig with RPGC normalization for the human genome.
Run ChIP-seq QC on these two BAMs: correlation and fingerprint.
say_en.note: Outputs correlation heatmap and fingerprint plot.

say_en.text: Plot a heatmap around the TSS of these genes, 3kb up/downstream.
say_en.note: Generates signal heatmap and profile plot.
